m.text: An alchemical cocktail made from rare components and delerium dust worth 250 gold, which the target consumes as part of the spell

entries: By means of this spell, you transform a mutation gained from {@adventure contamination|DoDk|12}. One of the target's existing mutations is removed and is replaced by a different one. This mutation may be chosen by the Game Master or determined randomly (see Appendix C of Dungeons of Drakkenheim).
name: Forced Evolution
